mapping.typed_note: slots carry channel ancilla/coupler roles; they are not replacements for the data qubits 4..8

protocol: occupancy/loss-check the four active channel ancillas before channel use

if exactly one active ancilla is detected lost and the spare is present, HOLD that channel, move the spare to the failed slot, reset/prepare it, verify occupancy/state, update the channel-to-slot map, then resume
if two or more active ancillas are lost in one epoch, HOLD the shell because one spare cannot restore four channels
if the spare is absent when an active loss occurs, HOLD
if a data/hub qubit is lost, QUARANTINE; this fiber only replaces channel ancillas
a missed active loss is UNSAFE and is reported separately from HOLD

typed_variables.ell_A: active-channel ancilla loss probability over the declared epoch
typed_variables.ell_S: spare loss probability over the same epoch
typed_variables.m: false-negative / missed-loss probability conditional on an active ancilla loss

motion_metric: exact Euclidean spare-to-failed-slot distance classes on the D5 ring

source_stress.NDSSR_only: ell_A=ell_S=0.01 from the published 2025 state-average NDSSR atom-loss figure; set m=mu=rho=nu=0 only as an optimistic partial-channel stress

claim_rule: replacement benefit is architectural/combinatorial until MOVE, reset and loss-detector confusion are source-bound at the target backend
